name: Z-Image: Turbo
description: Z-Image Turbo is a super fast text-to-image model of 6B parameters developed by Tongyi-MAI. It compresses inference to as few as 1-8 diffusion steps (default 8), delivering high-volume, low-cost image generation at $0.005 per megapixel while maintaining strong prompt adherence. Optimized for rapid prototyping, content variation testing, and high-throughput asset generation, with optional prompt expansion to enrich brief prompts automatically.
